howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: Drop an MP4/MOV/MKV file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Upload an SRT subtitle file
howto.text: Standard SubRip Text format with timestamps and dialogue.

howto.name: Choose to burn-in or soft-encode and download
howto.text: Burn-in: subtitles are rendered into the video pixels (permanent, plays everywhere). Soft: subtitles are a separate track (toggleable in supporting players).

faq.q: Should I burn-in or use a soft subtitle track?
faq.a: Burn-in: best for social media (Twitter, Instagram) where players don't render subtitle tracks. Soft: best for accessibility — viewers can turn off.
Input: SRT. Burn-in output: works in any video player. Soft track: MP4 with WebVTT or MKV with SRT — depending on output format.

faq.q: Can I customize the font / size / color?
faq.a: Currently uses sensible defaults (white text with black outline, sans-serif). Custom styling is on the roadmap.
